# Watch out: files with several measured risk signals

<!-- provenance -->
> **Extracted fact** from the code at commit `1a80fc8`, produced by static analysis with no AI model. Safe to rely on.


Files are ranked by signals measured from the code and its history: how many files depend on a file, whether tests sit next to it, how large and branchy recent changes were, repeated code, new links between modules and unfinished markers. Most signals are compared with this repository's own history, so a file is flagged for standing out here, not against other projects. This is a ranked list, not a score, and not a prediction about any file.
